name: Threaded discussion
summary: Replies are stored as a tree: each reply points to the post that it answers, so a reader can follow one branch of a talk.
how: Give each post an id and give each reply the id of its parent.
Show the tree with one indent for each level.
Quote or link the parent post in each reply.

origin.note: Usenet links each reply to its parent, and newsreaders show the replies as a tree.

adoptions.via: Web forum programs such as phpBB group the replies under one topic.
Reddit nests the comments as a tree and sorts each level by votes.
